teaser: Ten agents in sequence, a schedule that must land in the right session, and why visibility is half the work of an agent loop.
core_idea: Running a pipeline of about ten scheduled agents unattended is brittle: each needs a persistent, readable session holding state, keys and data, which only became workable when scheduling could target a chosen session, and reliability still depends on run records and visualisation, so the work goes slowly, leans on platform features, and moves next to a dedicated account, because the unit of work is the whole platform.
